en: Dependent on a limited state that is a root-cause, a non-exalted state that is not a root-cause arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are thirteen; under object-condition, nine … pe … under mutuality-condition, eleven … pe … under non-disappearance-condition, thirteen.

Dependent on a limited state that is not a root-cause, a state that is neither limited nor a root-cause arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are fourteen; under object-condition, fourteen; under predominance-condition, nine … pe … under non-disappearance-condition, fourteen.
